decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound builds directly on the firm's woodworking and assembly know-how, so management can interpret its results and refine the models within its existing knowledge base.
The one-tier arched pyramid is a core Erzgebirge-style product, fully within the firm's craft competence, and seasonal pyramids remain a stable part of its range.

Although the electronics lie outside the firm's own knowledge, the line has survived several seasons as a flagship, so the firm has learned how to integrate the sourced mechanism with its wooden craftsmanship.

The Christmas motif platform depends on the music box line and is more distant from the core, but its carved and painted seasonal motifs draw on the firm's skills, so it stays as a low-cost complement.
The Dresden-themed pyramid extends the firm's established pyramid craftsmanship and its regional design knowledge, which makes it easy to understand, maintain and improve.
